## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-census-a2a-card`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-census-a2a-card -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `data/cards.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.
